**Limitations**

- One very dark pixel or one very busy window changes M or R, and so the threshold everywhere.
- Wolf's own program copies the threshold of the nearest full window at the image edges and finds R over full windows only. PixelNexus fills windows with the border mode, as OpenCV does with replicate, so results near the edges can differ.

**Artifacts**

- Thin strokes can break where the contrast is weak.
